repository_holdout.role: secondary protected diagnostic; not part of the primary superiority margin

rationale.statistical_floor: FTR-104 established a five-net-task optimistic single-candidate significance floor. The 54-task primary margin is more than ten times that floor and is additionally subjected to the paired exact test.
rationale.distillation_buffer: An 8 percentage-point absolute public-coding margin deliberately reserves roughly 3 points for teacher-label/distillation approximation loss while still leaving a 5-point target improvement over the 4B base. This is an engineering authorization margin, not an estimate of guaranteed student gain.
rationale.selection_control: The gate is frozen before observing the exact teacher result and covers one fixed teacher/configuration comparison, preventing threshold selection after seeing the outcome.
